title: OpenRouter (LLM)
description: OpenRouter as an LLM tier: one key for models from many providers, through gohort's OpenAI-style client.
setup_notes: Create a key at openrouter.ai/keys. Model names are as OpenRouter lists them, provider/model. Choose it under Admin > LLMs > Worker LLM (or Lead LLM) as Service: <name>, where the tier names its model and the key can be changed; Test connection there makes one short real chat. The tier's turns run on it through gohort's own OpenAI-style client, streaming and tool calls as usual, and the key stays with the connection. Its calls and their cost show on the connector's row; add per_million_input and per_million_output to its spec's cost to price its tokens, which then replace the tier's rates under Costs.

questions.name: name

questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the LLM settings list it by this name.
